display_information.name: Grantweaver
display_information.description: Turn your nonprofit's conversations into funding.
display_information.long_description: Grantweaver is an AI grants agent for nonprofits. It discovers matched funding opportunities from Grants.gov, gathers impact evidence from your workspace in real time using Slack's Real-Time Search API (never storing your data), drafts cited proposals into Canvases, and keeps your whole grant pipeline on track — all inside Slack. Grantweaver stores permalinks, never message content; every fact in every draft links back to its source. AI-assisted drafts always ask for human review.

agent_view.agent_description: Finds grants, gathers cited impact evidence from your workspace, and drafts proposals into Canvases.
